offers_products.reason: Makes branded foods: SPAM, Skippy peanut butter, Planters nuts, Applegate, pepperoni, Herdez salsas.

offers_services.reason: Sells packaged food products; no main service offering.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Consumer brands like Skippy, Planters and SPAM are chosen by shoppers in grocery stores.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to retailers for resale and to foodservice operators and distributors.

recurring_revenue.reason: Food staples are repeatedly bought by retailers, foodservice customers and shoppers.

cyclical_demand.reason: Packaged food and groceries are staples; demand holds in downturns, though shoppers may trade down.

big_ticket.reason: Low-priced, frequent grocery items like peanut butter, bacon and canned meat.

people_delivered.reason: A food manufacturer; customers pay for packaged goods, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Households are main buyers via brands; large retailers also buy, but consumers are a key audience.

asset_heavy.reason: Operates meat processing plants and manufacturing and distribution facilities needing ongoing capital investment.

notes: Large_customers is a judgment call: big grocery retailers and foodservice distributors buy, but the brands target households.
